{{Quote|Who you calling 'old,' pal?|Solomahal, to Covah|<ref name="gg">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref>}}
'''Solomahal''', a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]], was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and other conflicts. Famous for liberating the [[Wode]] and defeating the [[Sun Guard]]'s [[2nd Regiment]], Solomahal had become a general by the time of the Clone Wars, during which he commanded a secret [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base on [[Azure/Legends|Azure]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] transported a unique codebreaker to Azure, but were followed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces; Solomahal refused to surrender in the [[Battle of Azure Spaceport|ensuing battle]] and was eventually captured by the Separatists. The Lutrillian prevented the codebreaker from falling into CIS hands, destroying it, and was able to escape custody and return to the line of duty.

After the close of the war and the establishment of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Solomahal became a fugitive, wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The Lutrillian went into hiding, becoming a [[Spacer/Legends|scout-for-hire]] operating out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]; he often helped [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] escape from the Empire in [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]]. Solomahal was a regular in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]], and it was here where he met [[Tzizvvt]], a secretive [[Brizzit]] treasure hunter. The two became fast friends and embarked on many adventures together.

==Biography==
===General Solomahal===
{{Quote|You are too cautious, Commander Kenobi. I think we can win this.|Solomahal on Azure during the Clone Wars|<ref name="sotj" />}}
A [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Solomahal joined [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military forces some time before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], serving with distinction. He became a hero after coordinating the defeat of the [[Sun Guard]]'s [[2nd Regiment]], a [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] group native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]], and for liberating the [[Wode]].<ref name="rat" /> When the Clone Wars broke out and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was formed, Solomahal became a [[General/Legends|general]] and was given command of a secret Republic base on the planet [[Azure/Legends|Azure]], which was of little consequence to either side in the war, and which the Republic hoped would go unnoticed. The base was quite undermanned, and every being Solomahal had under his command was constantly at work, with little respite.<ref name="sotj" />

[[20 BBY/Legends|Two years]] and five months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a trio of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]]&mdash; and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] acquired a foolproof codebreaker developed by technological expert [[Talesan Fry]], which they hoped would help in the war effort against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They took the object to Solomahal's base on Azure; excited by the prospect of earning more fame, he was barely able to hide his enthusiasm to the Jedi and told them of his hopes for Azure to become an important part of the turning point in the war. The Jedi, particularly Skywalker, disapproved of such optimistic talk. The Jedi stayed on the planet while attempts were made to contact the Republic and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], but Amidala departed; as Solomahal had no [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to spare, she was forced to pilot her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] herself.<ref name="sotj" />

[[File:Solomahal2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Solomahal]]
Just moments later, however, Solomahal learned of an impending Separatist [[Battle of Azure Spaceport|attack]] on Azure; CIS forces had placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] in the codebreaker and were preparing to launch an attack on Azure's main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Solomahal alerted [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]; any ships that were available would be sent, though the Lutrillian knew they would be far too late. He mustered what few ships he had on Azure's surface, which were bolstered by the Jedi, who flew [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Anakin Skywalker, a confident and occasionally brash young Jedi, advised Solomahal to split his forces into two groups; one, led by Skywalker himself, to act as a diversion while another waited on the surface. Although initially surprised that a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] would be giving orders to a general, Solomahal did not care that the idea was not his and implemented it.<ref name="sotj" />

Skywalker led an attack on the Separatist fleet, allowing Solomahal's ground-based artillery to fire on the lead CIS ship. The Separatists responded by preying on civilian ships, but using the codebreaker, Solomahal was able to anticipate the enemy's attacks and counter them when possible. Despite this, however, the general's forces were taking considerable losses, and Kenobi urged him to give the codebreaker to his best pilot and transport it offworld so it could not reach Separatist hands. The Lutrillian refused; he knew the codebreaker was all that was keeping them from being slaughtered, and he did not wish to lose his base. When the Jedi persisted in their attempts to persuade Solomahal to send the codebreaker away, he cut them off and refused to continue communicating with them. However, with Republic forces still over an hour away, the battle was lost and Solomahal's forces were overrun; finally taking the Jedi's advice, he attempted to escape with the codebreaker and transport it to a Republic-aligned world, but was captured in the process. Rather than hand over the unique technology, he destroyed it; the Separatists placed the Lutrillian in captivity, but he escaped just days later. He was given another post and continued to serve until the war's end<ref name="sotj" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="nec" /> by which point he had won many battles and become a hero.<ref name="rat" />

===Solomahal the spacer===
{{Quote|You said you needed to get away; I'm taking you away. ''Far'' away.|Solomahal, to Covah|<ref name="gg" />}}
When the Republic was dissolved and reformed as the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="rep78">[[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]]</ref> in 19 BBY,<ref name="nec" /> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] made sweeping changes to the military personnel of the former Grand Army of the Republic<ref name="rep78" /> and established [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]].<ref name="nec" /> As such, Solomahal became an outlaw, wanted by the Empire: his roles in the Clone Wars and other conflicts were stricken from the Imperial archives, his Republic pension was frozen, and his assets were seized. The Lutrillian veteran evaded all attempts at his arrest and became one of the [[Imperial Most Wanted List|Empire's Most Wanted]]; many suspected that he harbored sensitive information that the Empire wished to be suppressed. Additionally, scores of influential [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] families sent [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after Solomahal, for reasons he kept a closely guarded secret. He fled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and kept his former life a secret, though many remembered him as a hero of times past.<ref name="rat" />

Basing his operations out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the backwater world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Solomahal became a scout-for-hire, agreeing to transport beings&mdash;mostly those being persecuted by the Empire&mdash;to safe areas, for a price. Business was good, and before long he had amassed enough credits to purchase his own ship, the [[YV-888 freighter]] ''[[QuadStar]]''. He often worked in [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], where his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]], was located. Solomahal became well known in [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] circles, and over time he became the foremost scout of the area, with an intricate knowledge of worlds ideal for hiding away from Imperials. He generally spent his free time alone, in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] such as [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's]] and other taverns on the planet [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]]. Solomahal claimed to have a foolproof method of entering the administrative headquarters of the [[Figg family]], the widely hated rulers of Gerrenthum.<ref name="rat" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Solomahal was hired by [[Covah]], a [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] criminal wanted by the Empire, to deliver him to a safe world in Greater Javin.<ref name="gg" />

At some point,<ref name="Insider130">{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}} According to Leland Chee, Solomahal was not present during the events of ''A New Hope'', as the two Lutrillians pictured were [[Atheloe]] and [[Ownellco/Legends|Ownellco]].</ref> Solomahal drank with a [[Brizzit]] named [[Tzizvvt]] in [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun's]] Cantina in Mos Eisley; Tzizvvt was derided by the cantina's other denizens because of his stories of long-lost treasures, but Solomahal decided to humor him and arranged a meeting. Tzizvvt claimed to be a [[Archaeology/Legends#Xenoarchaeology|xenoarchaeology]] professor native to [[Jandoon]] and told Solomahal of his quest to locate a relic known as "[[The Eye of the Beyonder]]," which he insisted held a map that would locate hordes of hidden treasures throughout the [[Jandoon system/Legends|Jandoon system]]; to acquire it, however, he needed a ship and a crew.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|tzizvvt|Tzizvvt}}</ref> Afraid of being identified,<ref name="rat" /> the Lutrillian ended his meeting with Tzizvvt and left the cantina, telling the Brizzit he would meet with him again in several days.<ref name="db" />

Solomahal was dubious of Tzizvvt and began to investigate the Brizzit's claims; he called in a favor from [[Garindan/Legends|Garindan]], a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]], who used a pirated [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] station to determine that Tzizvvt was wanted by the Empire for stealing relics on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] and [[Biitu]]. Intrigued, Solomahal decided that the Brizzit most certainly was ''not'' a xenoarchaeology professor, but kept to his word for the meeting anyway.<ref name="db" /> Several months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Solomahal was in Chalmun's Cantina, when the Empire announced that they were imposing a curfew on the entire [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]; the old Lutrillian was one of the first to leave, but not before [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] the barmaid sang one last [[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|song]] for the night.<ref name="hs" /> Solomahal eventually did meet with Tzizvvt in the Brizzit's underground den in one of Mos Eisley's sewers, when he showed Solomahal several old relics and jewels he had captured in his time; Solomahal still took the Brizzit's outlandish claims with a grain of [[Salt/Legends|salt]], but he knew that Tzizvvt was sincere about his hunt for "The Eye of the Beyonder." Even though Tzizvvt could not pay him upfront, Solomahal agreed to take him to the Jandoon system in his ship, in exchange for a cut of the profit, and the two left Tatooine and began a quest for fortune and glory.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Solomahal3.jpg|thumb|left|Solomahal and Ackmena in Chalmun's Cantina.]]
{{Quote|It's a little early for surrender.|General Solomahal|<ref name="sotj" />}}
Solomahal was an eager combatant, and he constantly hoped to prove himself and earn more fame. He was a practical commander who knew how to coax the best out of his soldiers, and he was not above using ideas and plans he did not formulate himself. Solomahal was extremely stubborn; he hated to surrender and would ignore the urgings of others to do so. During the Battle of Azure Spaceport, he kept up the fight and refused to send the codebreaker away, knowing that to do so would mean that the battle would inevitably result in failure.<ref name="sotj" />

In his later years, Solomahal became very secretive; he had to be to ensure he was not discovered. Despite this, he was not adverse to reveling in the awe experienced by other beings when they heard the stories from his illustrious past. Confident, capable, and wise, he was regarded by many as a sort of father figure, with a quick draw and a steady piloting hand. As the Lutrillian had outlived most of his former comrades-in-arms, he was an aloof figure, usually alone and often unpredictable.<ref name="rat" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This alien has always had a military leaning. During shooting, it was known simply as 'The Colonel,' though another nickname was 'the Hare Mouse.'|Pablo Hidalgo|<ref name="Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>}}
[[File:SolomahalTzizvvt.jpg|thumb|right|210px|[[Atheloe]] meets with [[Tzizvvt]].]]
Solomahal was originally intended to be one of two Lutrillians created as background characters for the cantina scene in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The character was designed by [[John Mollo]],<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> and his mask was sculpted by [[Stuart Freeborn]] for shooting in England.<ref name="CRC">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The only distinction between the two costumes was an ascot worn by one of the extras.<ref name="MOSW">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> The production team for ''A New Hope'' referred to at least one of these Lutrillians as the Colonel,<ref name="CRC" /> and at least one as the Hare Mouse.<ref name="SWC" /> One or both of these characters was intended to be named [[Ownellco/Legends|Ownellco]].<ref name="CRC b">The article {{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}} conflates these two Lutrillians as the same, leaving it unclear which Lutrillian was due to be named Ownellco.</ref> However, in [[Star Wars Insider 130]]'s [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery: The Usual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley'']], published in [[December]] [[2011]], it was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] that both of the Lutrillians seen in ''A New Hope'' were in fact Ownellco and [[Atheloe]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}}</ref>

One of the Lutrillian masks was later used in the cantina scenes in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="blog WW">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref> marking Solomahal's first appearance.<ref name="hs" /> The character went unused and unreferenced until [[1997]], when the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] established that he was "Solomahal, a veteran officer of the Old Republic."<ref name="CRC" />

Since then, Solomahal has appeared in [[Jude Watson]]'s [[Prequel trilogy|Prequel era]] novel [[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']]<ref name="sotj" /> and in two [[Wizards of the Coast]] roleplaying game supplements: ''[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]'' and ''[[Rough and Tundra]]''.<ref name="rat" /><ref name="gg" /> He is also the subject of a card in the [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] set of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]; the image used for the card resembles Ownellco, the thinner Lutrillian from ''A New Hope'', although he does wear a scarf like Atheloe, the fatter member of the species.<ref name="JK">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Solomahal • Expert Scout|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/119Usolomahalveteran.html}}.</ref> ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan [[Tim Veekhoven]] used Solomahal in his successful [[What's The Story?]] submission for the character of Tzizvvt. The original entry established that Solomahal had visited the planet [[Tzizvvt|Illna]] during the Clone Wars, but this did not make the final, [[canon]]ical cut. Veekhoven also established Solomahal's relationship with Tzizvvt, which he based on the earlier cut of the cantina footage, which depicts Ownellco sitting by the insectoid [[Brizzit]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|teekay-421|13|They were the chosen ones}}</ref>
